summary: CI smoke-test job (runs on every PR) builds the wheel, installs into a fresh .wheel-venv, cds to /tmp, and runs the venv-scoped panopticon --version and a venv-python import — a real hard gate on isolated-install behavior; the pytest test locks in exactly those four isolation conjuncts (fresh-venv wheel install, cd out of checkout, venv-path executable, venv-path python import) so the check cannot be silently weakened.
